Commentary.Commentary: Out come the openers Imam-ul-Haq and Abdullah Shafique! We saw them play almost the whole of Day 5 in the first Test and they need to do something similar here. Mitchell Starc, the star of the first innings has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
... FOURTH INNINGS ....

Pakistan on the other hand, have to bat more or less the whole of 2 days to salvage something out of this game. Any other than an Aussie win would be an absolutely sublime effort from the hosts. Chasing this down is also a probability now as the hosts will have over 150 overs to do. However, that is probably what will not be in their mind at the moment, their first aim will be to head into Lunch unscathed. They will need to take it session by session and then analyze at the end of every one where they stand and how to go about the game. Australia on the other hand, will love another repeat of the first innings. Stay tuned for the reply.

AUSTRALIA HAVE DECLARED! Pakistan have been set a target of 506! Just under 30 minutes is what Australia played on Day 4 before declaring and 16 runs is what they have added. That declaration might have come as a surprise to a couple but nobody expected the Aussies to bat for long. They headed into this innings with a mammoth lead, managed to score quickly after not enforcing the follow-on on Day 3 and now have a little less than 6 sessions to bowl the opposition out.

OUT! TIMBER! Shaheen Afridi gets the breakthrough. He is delighted and pumped up. Some celebration for Pakistan! Back of a length, outside off, once again it keeps a little low. Marnus Labuschagne looks to work it on the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge and ricochets back onto the stumps. He departs for 44 and with that, Australia says the runs are enough. No new batter comes out to bat and Australia have declared at 97/2. They have a mammoth lead of 505 runs.
Length ball, shaping away, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne goes for the drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, outside off, Marnus Labuschagne offers no shot.
On a length, outside off. Usman Khawaja keeps it out. A good over by Hasan Ali.
Full, on leg. Blocked out.
Full and quick, on middle and leg. Usman Khawaja nudges it on the leg side.
Short of a length, outside off, again keeping a fraction low. Usman Khawaja covers the line and blocks.
Good-length ball, outside off. Usman Khawaja lets it sail through.
Outside off, Marnus Labuschagne steers it to deep point for a single.
That kept low! Length ball, around off. Usman Khawaja blocks it off the bottom half of the bat.
Length ball, outside off. Usman Khawaja lifts his bat and lets it go.
On a length, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Length, outside off, Usman Khawaja dabs it down to deep point for a run.
Full and on middle and leg, defended to mid on.
On length and outside off, Khawaja tries to steer it to third man but couldn't beat Fawad Alam at gully.
An inswinging ball, on a length, Marnus Labuschagne keeps it out.
Short of a length, outside off. Usman Khawaja taps it behind point and crosses ends.
Touch fuller, on off. Usman Khawaja prods and blocks it out.
Back of a length, on middle, Usman Khawaja gets behind the line and knocks it back to the bowler.
Sliding leg side, Usman Khawaja tickles it. Mohammad Rizwan does well o dive to his right and stop the ball. Saved a certain boundary there!
Fuller, on off. Usman Khawaja defends it out towards covers.
Jaffa! Good length, outside off, angling away at 143 clicks. Marnus Labuschagne tries to defend but the ball whistles past the outside edge.
Back of a length, outside off. Usman Khawaja works it one-handed on the leg side for a single.
On a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne dabs it to third man for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne Marnus Labuschagne steers it through cover-point for a couple.
Edged but didn't carry! Length ball, moving away, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne has a poke. The ball kisses the outside edge but dies on the way through. Falls well short of Mohammad Rizwan.
Length ball, angling in, on middle and leg. Usman Khawaja clips it to square leg for a single.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl from the other end.
Two more to end a good first over for the Aussies. Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point. The man in the deep runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to two.
Good length and on off, this one stays a touch low. Khawaja defends towards cover for one.

EDGY FOUR! First runs for today! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Khawaja looks to defend, he tries to do so away from the body. It goes off the outside edge down to third man for a boundary.
Over compensates now and bowls this one well wide outside off. Easy leave.
Errs down the leg side, Khawaja looks to flick but misses.
On the fuller side to begin with, outside off, Khawaja strokes it to covers.
It is time for the action to begin! The hosts walk out to the middle and they are followed by Usman Khawaja and Marnus Labuschagne who will continue their innings. Hasan Ali to begin.

Pakistan on the other hand, have a small hope of actually saving this. For that though, they will have to bat like they did in the first Test. First however, they’ll need to bowl tight, not concede a lot of runs. The wicket still seemed fine towards the end of Day 3, it hasn’t deteriorated a lot. However, a few balls did start to keep low and one believes it is only going to tougher. Welcome to the coverage of Day 4…

How surprised were you when Pat Cummins decided not to enforce the follow-on? We here found that quite astonishing but then it we realised, these conditions are quite tiring, the Aussies bowled a lot of overs in the first Test and they probably did not want their bowlers to be overworked. This could now result in two things, either Cummins will be praised for his bravery or he will be criticised for the the decision taken by him. He’s Pat Cummins though, he has done no wrong since being appointed captain. Also, there is still a LOT of time left in this game. Australia would probably bat another session, try add another 100 runs and give themselves around 5 sessions to bowl the opposition out.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

Right then! Australia have turned the tide in their favor and what was looking like another stalemate, now looks like a different story. Australia favorites to win now unless Pakistan pulls off a batting performance like Australia did in the first innings. Can they put up an inspired performance? Join us back on Day 4 to find out. The first ball of Day 4 will be at 10.30 am IST (5 am GMT) but as usual, our build-up will begin in advance. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Hasan Ali is down for a chat. He says that there's a difference in pace between the two sides. Tells that Australia's average was 140 while they are bowling at their best pace. Mentions that their batters didn't do well on this flat track either. Informs that they played a lot of cricket here. Says that the ball reverses a bit but if the batters can get through that, there are runs to be scored. States that they are hopeful as a team as they have performed well in the first game. He hopes that their top three batters bat as they did in the Rawalpindi Test.

A tough, tough day for Pakistan. They were not at their best with the ball, and they failed to put on a show with the bat as well. The pitch was assisting the batters but a few of them threw their wickets away. Babar Azam was the only batter who found some sort of rhythm in the middle, but he had no support from the other end. He too could not carry on till the end and perished in order to notch some up runs. Shaheen Afridi and Nauman Ali played vital cameos and took Pakistan to a score of 148. Coming to bowl again, they did grab an early wicket of David Warner. However, since then runs have been flowing for Australia. Pakistan will have to bowl better, although it will not matter much since they already trail by 489 runs. Babar Azam and his men have a mountain to climb from here and they need something special from their players to save this game.

What an enthralling day of Test cricket we have witnessed! A moving day indeed. Once again, the day has belonged to the visitors, and they continue to dominate this Test match. They started the day off by scoring some quick runs and set a healthy total of 556! They came into bowl with some intent and grabbed wickets at regular intervals. It was their pacers who were right on cue and were causing a lot of trouble to the batters. Mitchell Starc was the pick of the bowlers, he grabbed three wickets, while Pat Cummins, Cameron Green and Nathan Lyon took one wicket each. Not to forget the debutant, Mitchell Swepson also enjoyed himself, by scalping two wickets and sending back Abdullah Shafique with a perfect direct-hit. They dismissed Pakistan for 148 and came into bat once again and continued to score runs freely. They will be looking to add another 100-150 runs and set a big target for the hosts.
Full and on middle, Usman Khawaja strides forward and looks to defend. The ball goes off the inner half and past short leg for a single. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Flatter delivery, on the pads. Defended.
Slower ball, on middle. Usman Khawaja keeps it out.
Full and on middle and leg, Usman Khawaja plays a paddle sweep. The ball rolls to fine leg for a brace.
Full and outside off, Usman Khawaja is solid in his defence.
Flatter, on middle. Blocked out to the leg side off the back foot.

SIX! Pakistan players are hurt and this batting from Australia is adding more fuel to the fire. Tossed up delivery, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne gets to the pitch of the ball and smacks it over long off. Didn't hit it off the middle but still has enough legs to clear the ropes. A maximum!
Full and on off, pushed towards covers.
Loopy ball, on off. Defended to short leg.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked.
Angling in with the arm, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne puts a big stride forward and blocks.
Floats it up, on off. Usman Khawaja flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Usman Khawaja pushes it to the off side for a run.
Flighted delivery, on middle and leg. Usman Khawaja prods and keeps it out.

DROPPED! Tosses it up, around off, stays a bit little low. Usman Khawaja looks to defend it off the back foot but gets a little tickle. Mohammad Rizwan however fails to pouch it. A similar kind of delivery to which he got out in the first innings.
Outside off, worked to square leg for a single.
Full again, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne walks across and blocks it out.

FOUR! The Aussies further stamping that Pakistan's 148 isn't a real reflection of the pitch. Full and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne gets low and sweeps it to the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Another length delivery, outside off. Usman Khawaja defends it towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne dabs it towards cover-point for single.
Very full this time, outside off. Usman Khawaja squeezes it out towards point for a single.
On a length, shaping away, wide of off. Usman Khawaja offers no shot once again.
Back of a length, outside off. Usman Khawaja leaves it alone.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, fuller ball. Usman Khawaja leans to defend this but he misses and the ball hit shim on the pads. Half an appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved!
Tosses it up now, full again, around middle. Usman Khawaja defends this one.
Fuller again, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne pushes it towards cover for a  single.
FOUR! Another boundary! Lovely shot once again! Outside off, fuller delivery. Marnus Labuschagne leans and drives it past cover for a beautiful boundary!
Fuller again, around off. Marnus Labuschagne leans and defends this one.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! A fuller delivery, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Faheem Ashraf drops it short now, angling in on middle. Usman Khawaja swivels and pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length, outside off. Usman Khawaja miscues his drive towards cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne taps it towards point and rotates the strike!
Swinging in, outside off, on a length again. Usman Khawaja opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards point for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off, at around 129 clicks. Usman Khawaja blocks it out.
Angling in, around middle, on a good length. Usman Khawaja defends it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, Marnus Labuschagne punches it towards covers.
Full and on the pads, Marnus Labuschagne defends it.
Short and on middle, Usman Khawaja rocks back and guides it to deep point. He crosses ends.
Much fuller, around off. Usman Khawaja defends it out.

Slower through the air now, outside off, fuller ball. Marnus Labuschagne leans and looks to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge past the first slip fielder towards third man. The batters take three runs!
Shortish ball, outside off. Usman Khawaja stays back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Fullish this time, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne presses forward and defends it out.
Another length ball, around the fifth stump line. Marnus Labuschagne walks across and blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Smashes this one! Faheem Ashraf drops it short again, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne picks up the length and pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne defends it off the back foot.
Faheem Ashraf begins with a length delivery, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne stays in his crease and pushes it towards cover.
Full and sliding down leg, Usman Khawaja gets low and looks to sweep hard but misses. The ball goes off the pads and rolls to fine leg. The batters take a couple of runs.
Loopy ball, on middle. Marnus Labuschagne tucks it on the leg side off the back foot for a single.
This is pushed to sweeper cover now for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Floats it up, outside off. Usman Khawaja brings out the reverse sweep. He hits it well and in the gap to deep point for a boundary.
Very full, on leg. Usman Khawaja glances it to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Tosses it up, spinning away, outside off. Usman Khawaja look to drive but misses.
Time for some spin! Sajid Khan is brought into the attack. He replaces Shaheen Afridi.
Angling in around middle, on a good length. Marnus Labuschagne tucks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Much fuller now, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne pushes it back to the bowler.
Fraction shorter now, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne defends it towards point off the back foot.
On a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne stays in his crease and defends it out.

Edged..but that does not carry! Fuller ball, outside off. Usman Khawaja leans to drive, but the ball goes off the bottom edge towards the keeper. Mohammad Rizwan tries to grab the ball on the bounce, but he fails to pouch it and the ball rolls towards third man and the batters take a single.
Very full again, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leans and drives it towards deep cover for a brace.

Fuller now, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne presents the full face of the bat and pushes it back to the bowler. Shaheen Afridi collects the ball and mimics a throw and then stops and stares at Marnus Labuschagne. Shaheen Afridi is at it once again!
Back of a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne hops and taps it towards point.
Shaheen Afridi goes 'round the wicket now, serves a length ball, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
On a length, down the leg side. Usman Khawaja glances it towards fine leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Usman Khawaja drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Marnus Labuschagne gets the off the mark in style! Length ball, angling in, on the pads. Marnus Labuschagne uses his wrists and flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Much fuller now, angling in, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne closes the face of his bat and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, on a good length. Marnus Labuschagne tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Tad shorter, outside off, on a length. Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Marnus Labuschagne walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan have their first breakthrough! Hasan Ali strikes and gets rid of David Warner! This one was on a length, outside off. David Warner hangs back, opens the face of the bat tries to slice it in the gap between slips and gully. That was not off the edge, but unfortunately, he picks up Fawad Alam at gully, who takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Fawad Alam b Hasan Ali

Full again, on off. This time Warner drives it through cover-point for a run.
Touch fuller, on off. Warner pushes it towards covers.

Warnes taps this length ball towards covers for a quick single.

Shaheen Afridi starts with a length ball, well outside off. Usman Khawaja is not troubled by that and decides to let it go.
